sections.title: What Media Placement Is
content: Media placement is getting your brand covered in the publications your customers already read. A quote in an industry article. A byline under your founder's name. A feature that positions you as the company that understands the problem.

It is different from advertising. An ad is a slot you buy, and everyone knows it is paid. A placement is editorial. Your name sits inside the story, next to the writer's words, where readers give it more weight.
For commerce and SaaS brands, that weight is the point. Your buyers trust the outlets they read before they trust your site. Placement borrows that trust and points it at you.

sections.title: The Paths Into the Press
content: There are a handful of ways into a publication, and they are not equal. Knowing the difference is most of the work.

Earned coverage comes from reporters and editors who choose to quote or feature you. It carries the most weight and cannot be bought, only pursued. Contributor and expert programs let qualified voices publish bylined articles on major outlets. Sponsored sections are paid placements labeled as such. Wire syndication pushes a release onto finance and news aggregators for reach and social proof.

It is easy to pick one path and sell it as the whole map. We start with earned coverage, because it is the version that holds up when a customer asks how you got there, and we tell you which paths are paid when paid is the right call.

sections.title: How We Run a Placement Program
content: A placement starts with something worth saying. We work with you to find the angle a reporter would care about, the data you can stand behind, and the story only you can tell.

Then our writers do the work. They answer reporter queries on the platforms journalists use to source experts, pitch bylines to the right editors, and write the piece in your voice so it reads like you, not like a template.
You stay in control. You see every quote and every draft before it goes out. Nothing runs under your name that you have not read.

sections.title: Research That Earns Coverage
content: Reporters cover numbers. Original research is the fastest way to earn a mention, because a fresh data point gives a writer a reason to quote you and a headline to build a story around.
We turn what you already know into surveys, benchmarks, and trend reports built to get cited. One study can seed months of coverage across outlets, podcasts, and newsletters.

sections.title: Bylines Under Your Name
content: The strongest placements are bylined. Your founder's name over an article in a publication your buyers respect does more than a logo on a slide.
We ghostwrite the piece from your ideas, place it where it fits, and keep the voice yours. It becomes an asset you can point to for years.

sections.title: Placement Feeds Your AI Visibility
content: Coverage does more than reach readers. Brand mentions in trusted outlets are one of the strongest signals AI answer engines use to decide who to cite. Ahrefs found brand mentions correlate more strongly with AI visibility than backlinks (December 2025).
Every placement we earn works twice. Once for the people reading the article, and once for the models deciding which brands to recommend.

sections.title: Why Human Writers Win
content: Placement is a people business. Reporters respond to a real point of view from someone who knows the beat, not to a mass pitch.
The people behind Content Cucumber have worked in commerce for 30 years. We know the industries, the outlets, and the writers. Human writers, real relationships, and work you can put your name on.
When a placement is paid, we say so. You will always know whether a feature was earned or bought, because that difference is the whole point.

items.question: Can you get me into Entrepreneur or Forbes?
items.answer: Those outlets run contributor and expert programs that publish qualified voices, and we know how they work. We pursue the placement that fits your story and tell you which paths are earned and which are paid. We do not promise a specific logo, because anyone who does is selling you a paid slot and calling it something else.

items.question: Is placement guaranteed?
items.answer: Earned coverage cannot be guaranteed by anyone, because a reporter chooses to run it. Paid placements can be, because you are buying the slot. We tell you which is which so you know exactly what you are getting.

items.question: How is this different from a PR firm?
items.answer: Traditional PR retainers bill for effort and hand you a media list. We are writers first. We produce the piece in your voice, ready to run, and pursue the placement ourselves.

items.question: Do I have to write anything?
items.answer: No. You bring the point of view and the facts. We handle the writing, the pitching, and the placement. You approve every draft before it goes out.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Earned coverage moves on the reporter's timeline, often a few weeks to a few months. Contributor bylines are faster. We set the expectation up front for each path.

items.question: Is the coverage really written by humans?
items.answer: Yes. Every word is written by a person who knows your industry. That is the whole premise of Content Cucumber.
